comparison.objective: Clamp a welder work lead to the cracked arm without bridging its pivot versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Constraint-aware clamp placement versus recessed tool insertion, fine adjustment, counterholding, relocking, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp must contact the correct member and not span the pivot; electrical/contact thresholds are missing. Candidate requires quantified stop behavior and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Correct electrical clamp topology is unrelated to feedback-driven damper calibration.
